[1] «Ingo tetralogy | The Ingo tetralogy is a series of four children's novels, set in Cornwall, by British author Helen Dunmore. [2] «The Deep (Dunmore novel) | The Deep is a children's novel by English writer Helen Dunmore, published in 2007 and the third of the Ingo tetralogy (following "Ingo" and "The Tide Knot" and to be followed by "The Crossing of Ingo").»

It won the Nestlé Children's Book Prize Silver Award and was longlisted for the Carnegie Medal.»
[5] «Strands of Sunlight | "Strands of Sunlight" is a novel written by Gael Baudino in 1994.  It is the fourth in the Strands of Starlight tetralogy.  The other novels are "Strands of Starlight", "Maze of Moonlight", and "Shroud of Shadow". [6] «The Book of the New Sun | The Book of the New Sun (1980 – 1983) is a series of four science fantasy novels or one four-volume novel written by American author Gene Wolfe.  Alternatively, it is a series comprising the original tetralogy, a 1983 collection of essays, and a 1987 sequel.
